moderationWorkspace.title: Review *contributions*
moderationWorkspace.thanks: Thank you for reviewing. Every decision you make keeps the index accurate and fair for the people who rely on it. These guides cover what to check and how to decide.
moderationWorkspace.scopeHint: Only work in your review scope appears here.
moderationWorkspace.submissionsLead: Library changes, articles, claims and drives.
moderationWorkspace.discussionsLead: New messages, proposed edits and reports.
moderationWorkspace.optionSuggestionsLead: Accessibility features, services, facilities and library types suggested by the community.
moderationWorkspace.privateReview: Private to moderators in this scope.
moderationWorkspace.reportsLead: Compare the reported message with its current version before deciding.
moderationWorkspace.restrictionLead: Active restrictions and appeals in your moderation scope.
moderationWorkspace.noReportsLead: Reports from conversations in your scope will appear here.
moderationWorkspace.messagesLead: New messages and edits stay private until they are accepted.
moderationWorkspace.submissionsCaption: Review each submission before it changes a library or publishes content.
moderationWorkspace.overviewLead: Different contributions need different checks. Open a category to review the work within your queues and languages.
moderationWorkspace.overviewPrivacy: Counts include only work you can review. Your own submissions are excluded.
moderationWorkspace.librariesLead: New libraries, corrections, photos, sources and event feeds.
moderationWorkspace.articlesLead: Knowledge edits, translations and Journal submissions.
moderationWorkspace.claimsLead: Verify library staff affiliations and requests to manage a record.
moderationWorkspace.drivesLead: Review proposed drives, their scope, instructions and dates. Changes made through a drive stay in Library changes.
moderationWorkspace.applicationsLead: Review requests to become an editor or moderator within your remit.

moderation.no_domain_check_the_claim_has_no_email_o: No domain check: the claim has no email or website domain to compare.
moderation.approving_records_the_affiliation_and_ra: Approving records the affiliation and raises the claimant to Verified librarian. Roles are never lowered.
moderation.this_proposal_s_drive_could_not_be_read: This proposal’s drive could not be read.
moderation.too_big_to_finish_over_2_000_to_do_ask_f: Too big to finish: over 2,000 to do. Ask for a split by region, or reject it.
moderation.the_editorial_board_pins_and_features_dr: The editorial board pins and features drives.
moderation.this_feed_rsquo_s_details_could_not_be_l: This feed’s details could not be loaded.
moderation.the_submitter_no_longer_holds_a_claim_on: The submitter no longer holds a claim on this library. Reject this submission.
moderation.the_library_withdrew_or_disconnected_thi: The library withdrew or disconnected this feed. Reject this submission.
moderation.details_are_encrypted_moderators_see_onl: Details are encrypted. Moderators see only these masked hints; only Libraries Global staff can read a value.
moderation.no_facility_answers_in_this_submission: No facility answers in this submission.
moderation.approving_links_each_yes_to_the_library_: Approving links each Yes to the library and records each No as absent, then publishes the library.
moderation.nothing_is_waiting_on_a_contributor: Nothing is waiting on a contributor
moderation.location_saved_it_is_used_when_you_appro: Location saved. It is used when you approve.
moderation.something_went_wrong_check_your_connecti: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
moderation.approval_also_grants_the_submitter_owner: Approval also grants the submitter owner access to this library.
moderation.verify_their_staff_relationship_and_serv: Verify their staff relationship and service before approving.
moderation.where_it_goes_in_the_atlas: Where it goes in the atlas
moderation.approve_and_publish_needs_a_continent_co: Approve and publish needs a continent, country and region.
moderation.remove_this_suggestion_this_can_t_be_und: Remove this suggestion? This can’t be undone.
moderation.no_field_changes_in_this_submission: No field changes in this submission.
moderation.required_for_needs_changes_and_reject_sa: Required for Needs changes and Reject. Say what was wrong and what would be accepted.
moderation.approving_and_publishing_puts_this_live_: Approving and publishing puts this live: readers see it straight away. Check it reads well before you confirm.
moderation.you_re_reviewing_this_other_moderators_s: You’re reviewing this. Other moderators see it as in review.
moderation.you_can_read_everything_but_decisions_ar: You can read everything, but decisions are paused until they finish or their lock lapses after two minutes away.
moderation.choose_a_starting_point_then_edit_it_to_: Choose a starting point, then edit it to fit your review. Nothing is sent until you submit your decision.
moderation.shorten_your_note_before_adding_this_res: Shorten your note before adding this response (2,000 characters maximum).
moderation.everyone_who_can_publish_to_this_record_: Everyone who can publish to this record. Removing someone ends their access now and is recorded in the library’s staff audit.
moderation.nobody_has_staff_access_to_this_library: Nobody has staff access to this library.
moderation.their_staff_access_ends_now_any_live_ses: Their staff access ends now, any live session they started stops, and they’re emailed. They can claim the library again later, and a moderator will check that claim.
moderation.decline_this_suggestion_it_cannot_be_app: Decline this suggestion; it cannot be applied to the current timetable.
moderation.no_sections_to_confirm_in_this_submissio: No sections to confirm in this submission.
moderation.approving_marks_each_section_below_as_ch: Approving marks each section below as checked today. Nothing in the record changes, so check the live values against how they checked.
moderation.it_may_have_been_deleted_or_renamed_so_a: It may have been deleted or renamed, so approving changes nothing.
